source.title: 124. Milosrđe Božje - Radovati se onome čemu se Isus raduje!

summary.title_hr: 124. Milosrđe Božje - Radovati se onome čemu se Isus raduje!
summary.abstract_hr: Epizoda molitvene emisije medija Ora et Labora počinje molitvama za zaštitu i posvetama, a nastavlja se Krunicom Božjeg milosrđa, Litanijama Božjem milosrđu, Gospinom krunicom i molitvom Zdravo Kraljice. Slijedi tumačenje čitanja iz Poslanice Filipljanima, psalma i evanđelja (Lk 14,1.7-11) o tome da će onaj koji se uzvisuje biti ponižen, a onaj koji se ponizuje uzvišen. Voditelj povezuje radost svetog Pavla zbog toga što drugi navješćuju Krista s poniznošću. Kao test vjere predlaže pitanje raduje li se čovjek onome čemu se Isus raduje, odnosno obraćenju ljudi. Iznosi i osobno svjedočanstvo o otporu koji je osjećao prema pokretanju vjerskog podcasta i preseljenju u Međugorje. Na kraju najavljuje predstojeća predavanja i promocije te poziva na molitvu krunice u Zagrebu.
key_points: Sveti Pavao raduje se kad drugi navješćuju Krista, makar i himbeno. Voditelj to vidi kao znak Pavlove poniznosti i razlog njegova uspjeha u evangelizaciji.

Kao test vjere voditelj predlaže pitanje: raduješ li se kad netko drugi uspješno pronosi Isusovo ime i kad se ljudi obraćaju, te žalostiš li se zbog propadanja kršćanstva, primjerice u zapadnoj Europi?
Pavlov put u Makedoniju, bez sigurnosti i usred opasnosti, voditelj navodi kao primjer vjere koja se oslanja na vodstvo Božje riječi.
Prema evanđelju, tko se gura na prva mjesta i teži vlastitoj slavi bit će ponižen. Treba tražiti posljednje mjesto, a Bog će čovjeka u pravom trenutku postaviti na pravo mjesto.
Bog za velika djela često bira one koji to ne žele, ali pristanu iz poslušnosti. Može nekoga i dulje držati na nižoj razini odgovornosti dok ga duhovno ne pripremi.

Voditelj svjedoči da je dugo pružao velik otpor pokretanju molitve i tumačenja Božje riječi preko interneta. Bojao se da će kao poduzetnik uništiti posao i ugroziti obitelj, ali je poslušao Božji poziv i vidi plodove u obraćenjima ljudi.

Najavljena su događanja: promocija knjige u dvorani hidroelektrane Rama 31. listopada te susreti 2. studenog u Biogradu na Moru, 3. studenog u Solinu i 4. studenog u Imotskom, uvijek od 19 sati. Upućen je i poziv na molitvu krunice na glavnom trgu u Zagrebu.
key_topics_en: joy over the proclamation of Christ
key_points_en: Saint Paul rejoices when others proclaim Christ, even insincerely. The host sees this as a sign of Paul's humility and the reason for his success in evangelization.

As a test of faith, the host proposes the question: do you rejoice when someone else successfully spreads Jesus's name and when people convert, and do you grieve over the decline of Christianity, for example in Western Europe?
The host cites Paul's journey to Macedonia, without security and in the midst of danger, as an example of faith that relies on the guidance of the Word of God.

According to the Gospel, whoever pushes for the first places and strives for their own glory will be humbled. One should seek the last place, and God will place a person in the right place at the right time.
For great works, God often chooses those who do not want it, but consent out of obedience. He may also keep someone at a lower level of responsibility for longer until He prepares them spiritually.

The host testifies that for a long time he put up great resistance to starting prayer and interpretation of the Word of God over the internet. He feared that as an entrepreneur he would ruin his business and endanger his family, but he obeyed God's call and sees the fruits in people's conversions.

Events have been announced: a book promotion in the hall of the Rama hydroelectric power plant on October 31, and gatherings on November 2 in Biograd na Moru, November 3 in Solin, and November 4 in Imotski, always starting at 7 PM. An invitation was also extended to pray the Rosary on the main square in Zagreb.
summary.title_en: 124. Divine Mercy - Rejoicing in What Jesus Rejoices in!
summary.abstract_en: The episode of the prayer show of the media Ora et Labora begins with prayers for protection and consecrations, and continues with the Chaplet of Divine Mercy, the Litany of Divine Mercy, Our Lady's Rosary, and the Hail Holy Queen prayer. This is followed by an interpretation of the reading from the Epistle to the Philippians, the psalm, and the Gospel (Lk 14:1, 7-11) about how whoever exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted. The host connects Saint Paul's joy over others proclaiming Christ with humility. As a test of faith, he proposes the question of whether a person rejoices in what Jesus rejoices in, namely the conversion of people. He also shares a personal testimony about the resistance he felt toward starting a religious podcast and moving to Međugorje. In the end, he announces upcoming lectures and promotions and invites people to pray the Rosary in Zagreb.
